name: Blocks
description: Number of blocks indexed in the bucket

name: Block size
description: Block size in bytes (one sample per block)

name: Block interval
description: Seconds between consecutive blocks (one sample per block)

name: Empty blocks
description: Blocks without transactions

name: Transactions per block
description: Transactions per block (one sample per block)

name: Transactions
description: Number of transactions

name: Transactions with metadata
description: Transactions carrying auxiliary metadata

name: Fees
description: Fee per transaction in lovelace (sum = total fees)

name: Token transfers
description: Native-asset movements (one per transaction and unit that produced output)

name: Token mints
description: Transactions that created supply of a unit (outputs minus inputs > 0)

name: Token burns
description: Transactions that destroyed supply of a unit (outputs minus inputs < 0)

name: Transactions with native assets
description: Transactions moving at least one native asset

name: Value transferred
description: ADA in created outputs (sum = volume moved), in ADA because lovelace squared overflows the sumSq column

name: UTxOs created
description: Outputs created

name: UTxOs spent
description: Inputs consumed

name: Value received
description: ADA an address received (leaderboard dimension address/script)

name: Value sent
description: ADA an address spent (leaderboard dimension address/script)

name: Blocks produced
description: Blocks by producer (leaderboard dimension producer)

name: Live stake
description: Live stake per pool in the epoch snapshot (dimension pool)

name: Active stake
description: Active stake per pool in the epoch snapshot (dimension pool)

name: Blocks minted
description: Blocks a pool has minted over its lifetime (dimension pool), the source reports no per-epoch figure

name: Delegators
description: Live delegators per pool (dimension pool)

name: Voting power
description: Voting power per DRep in the epoch snapshot (dimension drep)

name: Token received
description: Quantity of ONE token an address received (dimension tokenHolder, needs a subject), movement, not a balance

name: Token sent
description: Quantity of ONE token an address spent (dimension tokenHolder, needs a subject), movement, not a balance

name: Stake pools
description: Pools in the latest epoch snapshot

name: Total live stake
description: Live stake across all pools in the latest epoch snapshot

name: Active DReps
description: DReps in the latest snapshot that are neither retired nor expired

name: Total voting power
description: Voting power across all DReps in the latest epoch snapshot

name: Stake registrations
description: Stake key registration certificates (needs the source's certificate crawl)

name: Stake deregistrations
description: Stake key deregistration certificates

name: Pool delegations
description: Stake delegation certificates to a pool, a Conway stake+vote delegation counts here and as a vote delegation

name: Vote delegations
description: Vote delegation certificates to a DRep, always-abstain or no-confidence

name: Pool registrations
description: Pool registration and update certificates

name: Pool retirements
description: Pool retirement certificates

name: DRep registrations
description: DRep registration and update certificates

name: DRep retirements
description: DRep retirement certificates

name: Other certificates
description: Certificates of any other kind (committee, MIR, ...)

name: Withdrawals
description: Reward-account withdrawals

name: Withdrawn
description: ADA withdrawn from reward accounts (one sample per withdrawal)

name: Zero withdrawals
description: Withdrawals of 0 ADA, which script stake credentials submit to run their validator, included in withdrawals.count

name: Delegations received
description: Pool delegation certificates naming the pool (dimension pool), a flow, not the delegator count

name: Vote delegations received
description: Vote delegation certificates naming the DRep (dimension drep)

name: Blocks
description: Number of blocks indexed in the bucket

name: Block interval
description: Seconds between consecutive blocks (one sample per block)

name: Empty blocks
description: Blocks without transactions

name: Transactions per block
description: Transactions per block (one sample per block)

name: Transactions
description: Number of REGULAR transactions (system extrinsics excluded)

name: System extrinsics
description: Substrate SYSTEM transactions (timestamp inherents etc.)

name: Transaction size
description: Transaction size in bytes (one sample per transaction)

name: Shielded transactions
description: Transactions moving shielded coins (source flag isShielded, set by its decode pass)

name: Transactions with ZK proof
description: Contract calls and shielded transfers (source flag hasProof, set by its decode pass)

name: Contract calls
description: Transactions of type contract_call, counted once the source's decode pass has settled the type

name: Contract deploys
description: Transactions of type contract_deploy, counted once the source's decode pass has settled the type

name: Failed transactions
description: Transactions whose result status is FAILURE

name: Fees paid
description: paidFees per transaction in specks, the DUST atom (1 DUST = 10^15 specks, sum = total fees)

name: Fees estimated
description: estimatedFees per transaction in specks (1 DUST = 10^15 specks)

name: Fee estimate error
description: paidFees minus estimatedFees per transaction

name: Blocks produced
description: Blocks by author (leaderboard dimension producer), sum is the bytes produced

name: Decoded transactions
description: REGULAR transactions whose ledger payload the source decoded, the base of the decoded metrics below

name: Zswap transactions
description: Decoded transactions with shielded (Zswap) inputs, outputs or transients

name: DUST consumed
description: DUST a transaction's spends declare (sum = total), in DUST because specks squared overflow the sumSq column

name: DUST spends
description: DUST spends in decoded transactions

name: DUST registrations
description: DUST registrations in decoded transactions

name: Zswap inputs
description: Shielded inputs in decoded transactions

name: Zswap outputs
description: Shielded outputs in decoded transactions

name: Zswap transients
description: Shielded transients (created and spent in one transaction) in decoded transactions

name: Contract calls
description: Decoded contract calls by contract (leaderboard dimension contract)

name: Circuit calls
description: Decoded contract calls by circuit name, across contracts (leaderboard dimension circuit)
